notes.title: New Game Content - Version 1.3.0 Update Now Available
notes.notes:
A brand new update is now available for our Tower Defense game. This brings about a new Map called "Hot Rod Racer" that has 2 Bases following a race track while the evil empire tries to take you down. This brings the total Maps in the game up to 25! This update also contains UI improvements for Steam Deck players.


New Map: Hot Rod Racer
UI Improvements for Steam Deck users, including larger menu buttons, Base, Bots & Spot sizes increased for better accessibility.
New Gamepad Cursor icon updated & improved

Have you had a chance to check out the upcoming spin off called ZaciSa: Idle Defense that is coming later in 2025?

This is a Tower Defense x Idle Clicker game set inside the Crayon Empire. Let the game build out your bases, upgrade your colorful forces and attack all oncoming enemy forces. Or take charge and control your destiny and fortify your defenses. As the game levels up and enemies get stronger, you will be rewarded new weapon choices and abilities.

Be sure to wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3264140/ZaciSa_Idle_Defense/

notes.title: New Game Content - Version 1.2.0 Update Now Available
notes.notes:
A brand new update is now available for our Tower Defense game. This brings about a new Map called "Spin-Span+Spun" that has 3 Bases circling a large ring with each Base having its own smaller ring for defense setup. This brings the total Maps in the game up to 24! Have you unlocked them all?


New Map: Spin-Span+Spun
Five brand new Achievements
Better Steam Deck support: Game now shows the full height on a Steam Deck!
Rocket Map updated with new assets from Game Rocket!
Ability to Quit Game easily
